description: Language-neutral cases of the bounded package content check: zip entries (text) in, verdict out. Every case runs against a stored and a deflated archive written by the fflate reference library. `padPart` appends that many bytes of XML comment padding inside the named part; `cutTail` removes that many trailing bytes of the archive.
